title: 036 US2: execution cost model from recorded Binance.US depth (pre-registered before any fit)
label: PROVISIONAL execution measurement; one recording period

data.snapshots: scheduled (one per pair per 15m candle) and order/exit snapshots from user_data/data/live_nnnc/<run_id>/depth-*.jsonl.gz; depth_missing snapshots excluded
data.volume: rolling 24 h (96-bar) quote volume of the pair up to and including the snapshot's candle, from the downloaded 15m OHLCV (causal)
data.cost: walk the recorded book for the stake against the mid, in bps; buy walks asks, sell walks bids; stakes beyond recorded depth flagged extrapolated and excluded from fitting

split: holdout = the last 25% of recorded calendar days (rounded up); fit on the rest

models.participation: per depth tier and side: isotonic cost vs participation p = stake / rolling 24 h quote volume (research/live_pnl/depth.py MonotoneCurve)
models.per_pair: per pair and side: isotonic cost vs stake (USDT); valid for the recorded period only

tiers: terciles of each pair's median top-20 quote depth (mean of bid and ask sides) over the fit days; 0 = thinnest
choice_rule: use `participation` if its pooled held-out median absolute error at the 900 USDT stake (both sides) is <= the per_pair model's; otherwise use `per_pair` and label every 2023-26 re-statement EXTRAPOLATED
tolerance: per pair: held-out median absolute error at 900 USDT <= 5 bps under the chosen model; a pair above it is EXCLUDED from re-statement and capacity (listed, never tuned)
coverage_floor: a pair whose scheduled snapshots are < 80% non-missing over the recording period is EXCLUDED
gate: fit only when research/live_pnl/gate.json is open (FR-019)
fees: not part of this cost; the backtest already charges 0.10% per side
